title: Welcome to life in the chip age
summary: Ryan sits down with Rakesh Kumar, professor of computer engineering at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign, about the astounding complexity of manufacturing modern semiconductors, the massive environmental and geopolitical footprint of AI data centers, and how AI models are rapidly shifting the future of chip design.
llm_summary: In a candid conversation, Professor Rakesh Kumar explains how today’s chips are built with astonishingly intricate processes that push the limits of manufacturing.
